**INTERNAL ESCALATION MEMO – IMMEDIATE ACTION REQUIRED**

**TO:** CFO (cfo@acme-analytics.example), Legal (legal@acme-analytics.example)  
**FROM:** TYR Contract Intelligence  
**DATE:** 20 October 2026  
**RE:** CRITICAL DECISION REQUIRED – Bengaluru Office Lease (LEASE-2025-001) – 10 Days to Deadline

---

## EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

The Bengaluru office lease (LEASE-2025-001) expires 31 December 2026…
subject: URGENT: Critical Decision Required - LEASE-2025-001 Non-Renewal Deadline 30 Oct 2026

citations.quote: The lease shall renew automatically for successive periods of 12 months unless the Tenant gives the Landlord written notice of non-renewal at least 60 days before the expiry of the then-current term.
On each renewal the monthly rent shall increase by 10% over the rent payable immediately before renewal.

leverage_notes: Critical dependency: BigRetail operations team is housed in this office. Any disruption risks 40% of revenue. Non-renewal decision MUST be paired with secured alternative premises. Landlord has no leverage if Acme has viable alternatives – market conditions may favor tenants.
